Title: Azure AD group-based licensing management is now available

Body.Content:
Scalably assign Microsoft service licenses to groups of users rather than individuals in Azure AD. Developer APIs also allow you to programmatically read group-based licensing assignments on groups, as well as programmatically get assignment status and errors. 

Learn more
